question: Which of the following organisations is associated with the development of the web version: e-GOPALA application?

options.text: National Institute of Agricultural Extension Management

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Dairy Development Board (NDDB)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Dairy Development Board (NDDB) was established in 1965 with the mission to promote, finance, and support producer-owned and controlled organizations.
 
• NDDB's programs and activities seek to strengthen farmer cooperatives and support national policies that are favorable to the growth of such institutions.
 
• NDDB has been instrumental in the success of Operation Flood, which was the world's largest dairy development program that transformed India into one of the largest milk producers.
 
• The e-GOPALA app is an initiative by NDDB to provide farmers with a digital platform for managing their livestock, including services related to breeding, nutrition, and health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **e-GOPALA Application**

 
 
• The e-GOPALA (Generation of wealth through Productive Livestock) application is a comprehensive digital platform developed to help farmers manage their livestock.
 
• It offers a range of services such as expert advice on animal health, breeding, and nutrition, and also provides information on the availability of quality breeding services, veterinary first aid, and AI services.
 
• The app also includes functionalities for buying and selling livestock, and it helps farmers track the reproductive cycle of their animals.
 
• e-GOPALA aims to enhance the productivity and profitability of dairy farmers by providing them with timely and relevant information.
 
 
 
• **National Dairy Development Board (NDDB)**
 
 
• NDDB was founded by Dr. Verghese Kurien, known as the Father of the White Revolution in India.
 
• NDDB's headquarters is located in Anand, Gujarat, India.
 
• The board works with various stakeholders including dairy cooperatives, state governments, and international organizations to implement dairy development programs.
 
• NDDB's initiatives have played a significant role in improving the livelihoods of millions of dairy farmers across India.
 
 
 
• **Operation Flood**
 
 
• Operation Flood was launched in 1970 by NDDB and is often referred to as the White Revolution of India.
 
• The program aimed at creating a nationwide milk grid that would link milk producers throughout India with consumers in over 700 towns and cities.
 
• It helped in transforming India's dairy industry from being a milk-deficient nation to one of the largest milk producers in the world.
 
• Operation Flood has significantly contributed to the socio-economic development of rural India by providing a stable income to millions of dairy farmers.
